description: This file defines the OrderService class, providing order-related operations such as creating an order, retrieving an order by ID, and listing orders for a specific store and customer.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Service class for handling order operations, including creation, retrieval, and listing of orders.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with the given merchant store ID, customer ID, currency, and list of order items, calculating the total amount.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its unique ID.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a specific merchant store and customer, ordered by creation date descending.
